findings.title: TLS certificate verification disabled process-wide, invoked at startup
findings.note: Fetch mutates the process-wide http.DefaultTransport to skip TLS verification, and is called unconditionally from main() against a live https URL, not a local/dev target. Every other consumer of http.DefaultTransport in the process is affected for the life of the process.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential-shaped literal committed to source
findings.note: Token-shaped constant named with a 'live' prefix sits in non-test source and is committed to git history; it is unreferenced elsewhere in the package but remains exposed to anyone with repo read access.

findings.title: String-concatenated SQL query on exported Store method
findings.note: Find is an exported method that concatenates its id parameter directly into a SQL string instead of using a parameterized query. No current in-repo caller was found, but the method is public API surface reachable by any future caller with unsanitized input.

findings.title: Shell-out via sh -c with unenforced trust assumption and suppressed lint
findings.note: The gosec suppression is backed only by a comment asserting caller trust, with no enforcement mechanism (no allowlist, no escaping). No current in-repo caller was found, so the trust boundary is unverifiable from the code itself.

open_questions.question: Fingerprint() using md5 has no in-repo caller; unclear whether any future use is security-sensitive (e.g. auth token) versus a cache key/checksum, which would not be a finding.
No caller of shell.Run was found in the repository; unclear whether external callers exist that could pass untrusted input, which would change severity.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: md5 use has no discoverable caller in the repo; per family rules a weak hash used only for a cache key or checksum is not reportable, and no evidence contradicts that reading.

not_assessed: Whether apiToken in internal/httpc/httpc.go is a live/valid credential or already revoked
Exploitability of the SQL injection in Store.Find given no in-repo caller was found
